name: auftraggeber/php-mail-interface
description: PHP-Interface to send mails from http requests.

check-licenses: vendor/bin/composer-license-checker check -a MIT -a BSD-3-Clause -a LGPL-3.0-or-later -a LGPL-2.1-only
phpcs: export PHPRC=/workspaces/php-mail-interface/phpcs-php.ini && vendor/bin/phpcs --config-set installed_paths vendor/phpcompatibility/php-compatibility && vendor/bin/phpcs . --ignore=vendor --standard=PHPCompatibility --runtime-set testVersion 8.5
phpcs-errors: export PHPRC=/workspaces/php-mail-interface/phpcs-php.ini && vendor/bin/phpcs --config-set installed_paths vendor/phpcompatibility/php-compatibility && vendor/bin/phpcs . -n --ignore=vendor/symfony --standard=PHPCompatibility --runtime-set testVersion 8.5
